# Stand Firm in the Storm
## Scripture
"Be watchful, stand firm in the faith, act like men, be strong." – 1 Corinthians 16:13
## Reflection
Paul's charge to the Corinthian church is a battle cry for every man who claims the name of Christ. Notice the progression: be watchful, stand firm, act like men, be strong. These aren't passive virtues—they're commands that demand intentional effort and disciplined resolve. The world will tell you to coast, to soften, to blend in. But the gospel calls you to something harder and better. Standing firm doesn't mean you never feel the wind; it means you plant your feet when it comes. Acting like men means taking responsibility, leading with courage, and refusing to shrink back when the pressure mounts. Strength here isn't merely physical—it's moral and spiritual grit forged in prayer, Scripture, and accountability. Today, you'll face moments that test your resolve: a temptation to compromise, a chance to lead, a reason to quit. Choose to stand. Your family, your brothers, and your witness depend on it. Real strength is built one faithful decision at a time.
## Daily Challenge
Do 25 pushups, and on each rep silently pray, "Lord, make me stand firm today."
